about: National Park Service (nps.gov): find parks by state, activity, topic or location; read park details, alerts, parking and conditions; search articles and multimedia; get photo metadata, video captions and NWS weather for parks.

commands.summary: Find National Park Service units, filtered by state, activity or topic, or sorted by distance from a lat/lng point

params.name: states
params.description: Two-letter state code(s), comma-separated, e.g. CA or CA,NV (see list-park-filters)

params.name: activities
params.description: Activity id(s), comma-separated, e.g. 3 = Arts and Culture (ids from list-park-filters)

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude of a search point (use with lng and sort='distance asc')

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. Use 'distance asc' only when lat/lng are given

commands.summary: Search parks by name or keyword (e.g. 'Yosemite') and get park codes, descriptions and coordinates
List all filter values for search-parks: topic ids, activity ids, state codes, and every park code with its name
Get NPS subject/topic pages related to a set of activity and topic ids, with the park codes linked to each
Get a park's overview (schema.org linked data): description, phone, address, visitor centers and opening hours

params.name: code
params.description: Lowercase 4-letter park code, e.g. jotr, yose

commands.summary: Get a park's structured operational data: addresses plus parking lots with capacity, live status, schedules and predicted occupancy
Get current alerts for one park: closures, road closures, cautions and information
List the nationwide sitewide alerts for all parks (closures, dangers, information) with park and state
Get a park's banner photo: image path, credit, alt text and crops
Search NPS photos, videos, audio and webcams by keyword, with optional Solr filter (type, park) and sort

params.name: fq
params.description: Extra Solr filter, e.g. Type:"Video", Type:"Photo", Parks_Item:"Yellowstone National Park" (full park name). Combine with AND

commands.summary: Search NPS articles, people and places pages by keyword (returns /articles/... URLs)

params.name: q
params.description: Keywords or Solr query, e.g. campfire or "National Park Week"

commands.summary: Read an NPS article page by slug (/articles/{slug}.htm)

params.name: slug
params.description: Article slug from the PageURL, e.g. campfires

commands.summary: Get NPGallery photo/asset metadata: title, description, credit/copyright, license, dimensions and EXIF
Download the WebVTT closed-caption transcript of an NPS video
Get place suggestions for a location string, with magicKeys to resolve into coordinates (US only)
Resolve a geocode-suggest magicKey into lat/lng (location.y / location.x) for search-parks
Look up the NWS forecast grid (office, gridX, gridY), nearest city, time zone and sunrise/sunset for a lat/lng

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude, max 4 decimals (more decimals cause a 301 redirect)

commands.summary: Get the 7-day NWS forecast periods for a grid point (from get-weather-point)
Get active NWS watches, warnings and advisories, optionally limited to a lat,lng point (e.g. a park location) or a state/area code

params.name: point
params.description: lat,lng with at most 4 decimals, e.g. 34.0114,-116.0975. Do not combine with area

params.name: area
params.description: Two-letter state or marine area code, e.g. CA or NC. Do not combine with point

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum number of alerts to return (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Get the latest observed conditions (temperature, wind, etc.) from an NWS weather station

params.name: station
params.description: NWS station id, e.g. LTHC1 (Lost Horse, Joshua Tree)
